diagnosis: D002 successfully turns discarded branches into a shadow sentence; that is a genuine advance over D001.
Its failure is surface burden: the full residue lattice is printed inline, so the poem reads as an audit report with a lyric excerpt.
The selected TRACE path is accurate but too instructional; it tells the reader what the apparatus does.
The strongest unit is the shadow sentence, because it is produced by omissions rather than claims about omissions.
The next draft should keep the executable packet, but let the readable poem be smaller and stranger.
required_change_for_next_draft: Split poem surface from branch apparatus: selected path plus shadow sentence in the draft; full lattice retained externally in branch_packet_003.json; selector map and renderer preserve addressability.
non_claim: This judges D002 only. P0001-D003 was created in the same turn and remains unjudged.
